defects.defect: Adding a Status__c != Inactive filter to the only list view, 'All', makes its label misleading and leaves no list view from which users can find archived storefronts; a separate 'Archived Storefronts' view (or renaming) was not considered. Lightning's default Recently Viewed view is also not covered (acknowledged only in Section 6).
Retention mechanism in Resolved is tagged _assumption_ although the user explicitly accepted the recommended default; it should be tagged as a user decision.
